sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Printleaf is an online commercial printing company that provides high-end digital and offset printing services to businesses nationwide, offering next-day and same-day production.

Industry: Printing · HQ: New York City, USA · Size: <$50M · Products: Digital and offset printing services, Marketing collateral, Large format prints, Custom wall decals, Window clings, Business cards

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Printleaf scores 54 of 100 (tier C) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (24/30), event engagement (8/15) and pain-point alignment (10/15).

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on cleanability, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar surfaces clean up with mild detergent, no abrasives, no gloss loss. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (18% similar on printing, vinyl, digital, print); Drytac (11% similar on printing, wall, print, media); ORAFOL Europe (8% similar on printing, digital, graphics, business). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.
